description: This is a PHP source file defining the EmailDao class, which provides data access methods related to Email and EmailTemplate entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to retrieve an email by name and to fetch matching email templates based on various criteria.

classes.name: EmailDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for Email and EmailTemplate entities, providing methods to query email data and templates from the database.

methods.name: getEmailByName
methods.description: Retrieves an Email entity matching the given name.

methods.name: getEmailTemplateMatches
methods.description: Fetches email templates matching the given email name, locale, and optional recipient and performer roles.
